## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Identify the affected layer
(protocol, storage, transport, runtime, Hub, or documentation).

## Verification

List the checks run and their results. For native behavior, distinguish compile
results from physical-device results and name any untested paths.

## Compatibility

Describe protocol/package changes, migration needs, and privacy or dependency
impacts if applicable. Use synthetic examples; omit credentials and user data.
